decisions.location: Experiment 1 Discussion, lines 531–533 (see also Introduction lines 188–190; Experiment 1 Results Table 2 lines 376–380; Experiment 1 Discussion lines 499–507; Conclusions lines 850–854; References line 1066)
decisions.reason: Experiment 1 (N = 93 analyzed) specifically added Raven's Advanced Progressive Matrices (RAPM) alongside the two auditory sequence perception tasks to empirically retest Foxton et al.'s (2003) published findings that performance on both types of auditory sequences correlates positively with RAPM and with each other (r = .45 without concurrent articulation). Note that Macken et al. (2009) did not administer RAPM, so the RAPM–auditory sequencing test directly retests Foxton et al. (2003) rather than a chain through Macken et al. (2009). In Table 2 and the Experiment 1 Discussion, the authors report non-significant correlations with RAPM (r = -.05 to .03) and between the two sequencing tasks (r = .06) and explicitly conclude that these results failed to replicate Foxton et al. (2003). Bibliographic identity is verified in the reference list (line 1066) and Crossref metadata (10.1038/nn1035). The sole shipped row (input_row_index 2353: Macken, Phelps, & Jones, 2009, 10.3758/pbr.16.1.139) and all sibling targets are distinct studies by different author teams in different venues, so report equivalence does not apply. Prior adjudication/state files were absent at their supplied paths; Luna's quote validation failed only because it stripped source newlines around the parenthetical year.
